scenario: A caller claims he accidentally sent money and requests a UPI refund. He pressures the user to accept a collect request. The victim is tricked into approving the payment.
advice: Never approve UPI collect requests from strangers claiming mistaken transfers.

scenario: A stranger sends a QR code insisting it will credit money. The user scans it thinking it’s for receiving payments. Instead, money gets debited from their account.
steps: Use only official merchant QR codes
advice: QR codes are for payments, not receiving money — never scan unknown ones.

scenario: A scammer pretends to buy an item online and sends a fake UPI request. They convince the seller that accepting the request will credit funds. The seller unknowingly pays instead.
steps: Confirm payment via your bank app
advice: For selling items, accept only actual payments, never UPI requests.

scenario: A caller impersonates a service provider asking for OTP verification. They claim account verification is required urgently. The OTP is used to access the victim’s accounts.
advice: OTP is private and never required over calls or SMS from agents.

scenario: An SMS warns that the user’s KYC is expiring and account will be blocked. A link leads to a fake portal stealing credentials. User unknowingly shares sensitive information.
advice: Banks never threaten immediate account suspension over SMS links.

scenario: A user receives an email about new security updates with a login link. The page imitates a bank login portal. Credentials entered are captured for unauthorized access.
steps: Avoid entering details in emailed links
advice: Never log in to financial accounts through emailed links.

scenario: A social media post promises high earnings for simple tasks. The scammer asks for registration fees to start work. After paying, the user is blocked.
advice: Legitimate jobs never ask for upfront payments.

scenario: A caller claims to offer a premium job placement for a fee. They promise guaranteed interviews. Once payment is made, they disappear.
advice: Guaranteed job placement offers requiring fees are usually fraudulent.

scenario: A person on chat groups claims investments will double within days. They share fake screenshots of previous profits. Users lose money after sending funds.
advice: High returns with no risk are classic scam indicators.

scenario: A user is lured into a trading app through ads showing huge returns. They deposit funds but cannot withdraw. Support numbers stop responding.
advice: Trade only on regulated platforms, not unknown apps promising rapid income.

scenario: A fraudster obtains a duplicate SIM by impersonating the user. They gain control of SMS alerts and OTPs. Bank accounts get compromised.
advice: Protect your mobile identity — SIM misuse enables account takeover.

scenario: A loan app promises instant credit without documents. After installation, it demands access to contacts and photos. Later, it harasses users for fabricated charges.
advice: Loan apps demanding intrusive permissions are unsafe.

scenario: A caller offers to increase credit limit instantly. They ask for card details and OTP. The information is misused for unauthorized transactions.
advice: Banks never ask for card details or OTP on calls.

scenario: A user searches online for support numbers and calls an unverified listing. The scammer pretends to assist but extracts sensitive details.
advice: Always use official customer support sources, not random listings.

scenario: An email warns of unusual account activity with a clickable button. The linked site collects login data. Funds are accessed without permission.
advice: Never click urgent security-warning links in emails.

scenario: A text claims unauthorized debit of a large amount. It provides a link to cancel the transaction. Victims enter credentials to stop a fake transaction.
advice: Banks never send cancellation links via SMS.

scenario: A profile mimicking a known acquaintance requests urgent money. They pretend to be in trouble and demand immediate UPI transfer.
advice: Always confirm emergency money requests directly with the person.

scenario: A person on a dating platform gains trust over days. They eventually request money for emergencies, never returning it.
advice: Emotional manipulation is common in dating scams — stay cautious.

scenario: A fake buyer insists on paying via UPI request instead of direct transfer. They send screenshots of fake payments to trick sellers.
steps: Validate payment in your bank app
advice: Always check actual credited amount — screenshots can be faked.

scenario: A seller lists a product at a very low price. They demand advance payment to dispatch. After receiving money, they vanish.
advice: Never pay in advance to unknown online sellers.

scenario: A caller says the user’s power will be disconnected for unpaid bills. They push to install a link-based app to clear dues.
advice: Disconnection threats over calls are common fraud tactics.

scenario: A fake delivery agent asks for an OTP to confirm address. The OTP actually activates unauthorized transactions.
steps: Confirm delivery details via official app
advice: Delivery OTPs are only for order changes, not address confirmation.

scenario: A message says the user’s wallet is restricted and asks to update KYC. The provided link leads to a phishing page stealing credentials.
advice: KYC updates should only be done in the official app.

scenario: A caller offers a special insurance plan with high returns on maturity. They ask for initial premium transfer to a private account.
advice: Insurance purchases should be made directly through official channels.

scenario: An online promoter claims to help users earn profits through crypto trading. They ask for deposits into a private wallet. Withdrawals are blocked once the money is transferred.
advice: Only use recognized crypto exchanges and avoid private wallet transfers.

scenario: A website promises high daily returns from crypto mining. Users deposit money but earnings never materialize. The site disappears after collecting funds.
advice: Crypto mining platforms with guaranteed profits are usually scams.

scenario: A profile offers instant personal loans without documents. They demand processing fees upfront. After payment, they block the borrower.
advice: Never pay advance fees for instant loans on social platforms.

scenario: A scammer claims the user is eligible for EMI refund benefits. They ask for UPI details to “process the refund,” tricking victims into paying instead.
advice: EMI refunds are never processed through UPI collect requests.

scenario: An SMS promises large cashback if the user clicks a link. The phishing site steals login details and empties the wallet.
advice: Cashback offers should be verified only inside official wallet apps.

scenario: A caller claims the user’s pension needs re-verification. They ask for Aadhaar and bank details to “continue monthly credit.” Fraudsters misuse the data.
advice: Pension updates are handled only through official government portals.

scenario: A fake landlord sends a UPI request saying it’s for “token amount confirmation.” The tenant unknowingly approves a payment request.
advice: Token payments should not be made via UPI collect requests.

scenario: A message says a courier is held due to unpaid customs fees. The link leads to a fake payment portal capturing card details.
advice: Customs fees are not collected through random SMS links.

scenario: A fraudster claims to offer discounted mobile recharges. Victims pay upfront but never receive the recharge.
advice: Discount recharges from unknown individuals are usually scams.

scenario: An SMS claims the user must update subsidy details to continue receiving benefits. The link steals bank information.
steps: Check subsidy status on official portal
advice: Subsidy updates should be done only via official government websites.

scenario: A caller pretends to be from a verification team and asks personal questions. Collected data is used for identity theft.
advice: Verification teams never ask for complete personal details over phone.

scenario: A portal advertises scholarships requiring small processing fees. After payment, no scholarship materializes.
advice: Genuine scholarships do not require upfront processing fees.

scenario: Someone calls saying the user’s insurance claim is approved but needs account details for “final settlement.” Information is later misused.
advice: Insurance claims are never settled through phone-based bank detail sharing.

scenario: A fake delivery agent demands a small UPI payment to release a package. After payment, the parcel never arrives.
advice: Courier companies do not demand random delivery fees via UPI.

scenario: A popup claims the device is infected and urges calling a support number. Scammers demand remote access and payment.
advice: Popups claiming malware infection are often fake scare tactics.

scenario: A scammer posing as an investment advisor promises high returns on mutual funds. They ask for direct transfers to personal accounts.
advice: Invest only through registered mutual fund platforms.

scenario: A scammer offers refund assistance for cancelled bookings. They ask for UPI details and initiate a collect request.
steps: Check refund status in official portal
advice: Refunds are processed automatically, not through UPI collect requests.

scenario: A promoter claims users can invest in digital gold with guaranteed returns. After investing, users find the website inaccessible.
advice: Digital gold investments must be done only via trusted platforms.

scenario: A message claims the user won a premium shopping voucher. The link leads to a phishing site asking for card and wallet details.
advice: Free voucher messages are mostly phishing attempts.

scenario: A scammer asks for urgent donations for a fabricated cause. Emotional stories are used to pressure victims into sending money.
advice: Donate only to verified charities with transparent operations.

scenario: An SMS urges installing an app update via an external link. The APK steals banking information.
steps: Install apps only via official stores
advice: App updates should always be performed via official app stores.

scenario: A contact forwards a link promising free rewards. The site requests login credentials to unlock the reward.
advice: Ignore forwarded reward links — they are often credential theft traps.

scenario: A caller claims the user’s subscription is expiring and must be renewed immediately. They demand payment through UPI.
advice: Always renew subscriptions only via official platforms.

scenario: A website offers premium coaching at low fees. After payment, no classes are provided.
advice: Enroll only in verified coaching platforms with transparent processes.

scenario: A caller claims the insurance policy is expiring and demands immediate payment. They insist on transferring to a personal account.
advice: Insurance renewals should always be done directly through official channels.

scenario: A caller claims the user’s credit card will be blocked due to suspicious usage. They ask for card details and OTP to ‘verify identity.’ The information is used for unauthorized charges.
advice: Banks never ask for OTP or full card details on calls.

scenario: A scammer posing as a property owner sends virtual tours and insists on a deposit to ‘confirm booking.’ After receiving payment, they disappear.
advice: Never transfer deposits without verifying property ownership.

scenario: A message claims the user must pay an exam form correction fee. Fake portals mimic official websites to capture details.
advice: Education-related payments should always be made on verified portals.

scenario: A message says a parcel delivery failed and provides a link to reschedule. The site steals payment details.
steps: Verify delivery via official courier app
Enter tracking number only on official site
advice: Reschedule deliveries only through official courier applications.

scenario: A random link promises cashback on spinning a digital wheel. The reward page demands card details to claim the prize.
advice: Reward wheels and free cashback links are common phishing traps.

scenario: A scammer posing as support tells the user to screen-share their banking app to ‘check an issue.’ They note the PIN inputs to access the account.
advice: Never screen-share your banking app with anyone.

scenario: A self-proclaimed trading expert promises guaranteed profits. They charge monthly fees and provide manipulated signals to keep users investing.
advice: Trading mentors offering guaranteed returns are usually fraudulent.

scenario: A scam link claims the user must update ration card details. The portal collects Aadhaar and banking data.
steps: Avoid filling forms on unknown sites
advice: Ration card updates must be done only via government portals.

scenario: Players receive messages offering exclusive in-game items. The link demands wallet or UPI payments to unlock the reward.
advice: Reward offers outside the official game store are usually frauds.

scenario: A scammer claims flight cancellation refunds need manual approval via UPI. They initiate a collect request pretending it's a refund.
advice: Airlines never process refunds through UPI collect requests.

scenario: An SMS says EMI payment failed and asks the user to click a link to retry. The site captures card data.
steps: Use lender app to check EMI
advice: Always pay EMI only through official lender apps.

scenario: A scammer urges donations for disaster relief and sends a UPI request. The cause is fabricated.
advice: Donate only through recognized charity websites, not private UPI IDs.

scenario: A scammer assigns simple data-entry tasks and pays initially. Later they demand deposits to unlock bigger tasks, then vanish.
advice: Jobs requiring deposits to continue are textbook scams.

scenario: A caller claims the user’s credit score is dropping and demands fees for instant improvement. The promised service never occurs.
advice: Credit scores cannot be instantly increased by paying individuals.

scenario: A scammer pretends to be from the e-commerce verification team. They ask sellers for OTP claiming to confirm their store identity.
advice: Marketplace teams never ask for OTP verification via calls.

scenario: A clone app mimicking a popular payment app is shared on social media. On installation, it collects login credentials.
steps: Download apps only from official store
advice: Always verify payment app authenticity before installation.

scenario: A link claims to enable cashback AutoPay rewards. Instead, it activates unauthorized recurring debits.
advice: Enable UPI AutoPay only inside your official banking app.

scenario: A caller promises loan waiver benefits for a small processing fee. Victims pay but no waiver occurs.
advice: Loan waivers are government-driven and never require private fees.

scenario: An SMS claims PAN must be updated urgently or will be blocked. The link steals personal and financial data.
steps: Update PAN only on official portal
advice: PAN updates never require clicking unknown SMS links.

scenario: A promoter offers luxury holiday packages at extremely low prices. After payment, bookings turn out to be fake.
advice: Be cautious of deals that are far cheaper than market rates.

scenario: A scam link claims the user has won UPI cashback. The site asks for UPI PIN under the guise of verification.
steps: Use only official app for rewards
advice: UPI PIN is never required for receiving cashback.

scenario: A scammer says a subscription auto-renewed and offers cancellation assistance. They initiate a collect request pretending it will ‘refund’ money.
advice: Refunds are never processed through UPI collect requests.

scenario: A message claims the user has an unpaid parking fine and must pay immediately. The link leads to a phishing portal.
steps: Check fines on official transport website
advice: Transport departments never send fine payment links via random SMS.

scenario: A website offers instant certificates for a fee. After payment, the certificate is not recognized by any institution.
advice: Certificates from unrecognized institutions hold no value.

scenario: A caller claims the user’s ATM card needs verification to avoid blocking. They ask for card number and PIN under the guise of updating records.
advice: Banks never ask for card PIN or full details on calls.

scenario: A scammer sends a payment request posing as a school representative. They demand immediate tuition fee clearance via UPI.
steps: Check fee structure on official portal
advice: Always verify fee demands directly with the institution.

scenario: Someone circulates emotional videos and requests UPI donations for a fabricated cause. Funds are transferred to personal accounts.
advice: Donate only to registered and verifiable charity organizations.

scenario: A message promises cashback if the user enters a code on a suspicious website. The form collects personal and banking details.
steps: Avoid entering details on unknown sites
advice: Cashback codes must be redeemed only on official apps.

scenario: A caller offers a pre-approved housing loan at extremely low interest rates. They demand processing fees upfront.
advice: Legitimate housing loans never require pre-payment for approval.

scenario: A scammer offers detailed bank statements for a charge and asks for login credentials. The data is used to take over accounts.
advice: Bank statements should only be downloaded from official bank websites.

scenario: A message claims the user can receive free crypto by sending a small amount first. After sending, nothing is received back.
advice: Crypto giveaways never require upfront payments.

scenario: A caller pretends to be from an NGO collecting funds for relief work. They request personal details and donations to a private UPI ID.
advice: NGO donations must always go through verified channels.

scenario: An agent promises unusually high interest rates for a small savings plan. They ask users to transfer funds directly to their personal account.
advice: High-return savings plans from unknown agents are risky and often fake.

scenario: A message claims the user must upgrade their wallet version or lose balance. The link installs a malicious app.
advice: Wallet upgrades must only be done through official app stores.

scenario: A caller insists the user must update their bank beneficiaries immediately. They ask for login details to ‘assist’ with the process.
advice: Beneficiary updates should always be done by the account holder only.

scenario: A scammer claims to be a surveyor assessing insurance claims. They ask for sensitive policy and bank details.
advice: Insurance surveys never require bank details from the customer.

scenario: A message offers moratorium benefits on EMIs for a fee. The link leads to a portal that steals card details.
advice: Moratorium benefits never require paying a separate fee.

scenario: A message warns that wallet KYC is suspended and urges clicking a link to restore it. The fake page collects identity details.
advice: KYC updates should always be done inside the original wallet app.

scenario: A scammer claims the user can get a verified badge for a small payment. After paying, no verification occurs.
advice: Verification badges are granted only by the platform, not by individuals.

scenario: A message claims the user has won a lottery prize but must pay taxes upfront. After paying, the scammer vanishes.
advice: Legitimate lotteries never ask for upfront payments or taxes.

scenario: A caller claims the user is eligible for compensation for recent rides and asks for UPI details for refund processing.
advice: Refunds are issued automatically to the original payment method.

scenario: A portal offers massive discounts on branded items. After payment, items never arrive or are counterfeit.
advice: Be cautious of websites offering extremely low prices with no credibility.

scenario: A scammer sends a link urging immediate Aadhaar update to avoid service disruption. The fake form captures sensitive identity data.
advice: Aadhaar updates must only be done through official centers and portals.

scenario: A message states a parcel is stuck due to unpaid shipping charges. The link demands small UPI payment, which is stolen.
steps: Check courier status on official site
advice: Courier companies do not collect fees via unknown payment links.

scenario: A scammer claims a paid subscription was activated and offers cancellation help. They request remote access.
advice: Do not grant remote access to unknown callers under any circumstances.

scenario: A scammer pretends to sell land and asks for a token amount to block the plot. After payment, the seller becomes unreachable.
advice: Token payments for property must be made only after legal verification.

scenario: A message claims PAN details require urgent correction. The link leads to a phishing portal mimicking government sites.
advice: PAN correction should be done only on official tax portals.

scenario: A scammer sends an SMS claiming unpaid highway toll. The link demands card details for instant payment.
steps: Verify toll logs on official FASTag portal
advice: Toll fines are updated only on official FASTag portals.

scenario: A message offers instant UPI cashback and encourages clicking a link. The site tricks users into entering UPI PIN.
advice: UPI PIN must only be entered inside your own UPI app.

scenario: During festive seasons scammers promote huge discounts with fake websites. Users who pay never receive products.
steps: Avoid festival deals from unknown sites
advice: Festival offer scams rise during holidays — stay alert.
